text: {"domains":{"block_M":[64,128],"block_N":[64,128],"block_K":[32,64],"num_stages":[1,2,3],"threads":[128]},"shared_memory_limit":49152,"weights":{"traffic":1.0,"launches":0.3,"pipeline":0.9,"footprint":1.1},"rationale":"GEMM 2048x2048x2048 float16 with fp32 accumulation. All listed block_M (64,128), block_N (64,128), and block_K (32,64) divide M=N=K=2048, so the full allowed domain remains supported by the first kernel family. threads is fixed to 128 by the allowed set. shared_memory_limit=49152 keeps a conservative development bound while permitting large tiles with multiple stages; the analytic footprint cap constrains the MIP choice. Based on feedback, the prior optimal picked num_stages=1, indicating pipeline weight was too weak relative to footprint. I raise pipeline weight to 0.9 and footprint to 1.1 to discourage under-staged selections and better reflect shared-memory pressure, while lowering launches to 0.3 since 2048x2048 offers ample work and launch count is a minor analytic factor. Traffic remains the primary objective at 1.0. This is still purely analytic MIP-based selection: compilation is unavailable (sm_121a adapter not integrated), simulation was not run, and CPU-shadow correctness or latency does NOT establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance. No timings are inferred without SASS, and no checked GPU results are claimed."}
